<thought>We need to determine the number of aromatic carbon atoms in the sample's compound. The only way to get information about carbon environments is to measure the 13C NMR spectrum using the provided tool. We'll request the carbon NMR data, then count the signals that fall in the typical aromatic region (≈110–160 ppm). This will give the number of aromatic carbons.</thought>
